cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.
